column3: The repeated writing of trouble is recast as issuing oppressive decrees.
“Or” connects the actions where the Hebrew has “and.”
“He will say” supplies an introduction to the change to first person.
“Rulers” specifies the inhabitants who are brought down.
“Assyria” and “warriors” supply referents for his fat ones.
“Assyria” supplies the referent of the possessive.
“The Egyptians did” personalizes the comparison with the way of Egypt.
The BSB adds “against you” as the object of the fury.
“Your neck will be too large” explains the image of fatness rather than retaining it.
